scenes.caption: A statue.
scenes.say: Hamza reads about a golden statue above a city.

scenes.caption: A swallow.
scenes.say: A swallow rests at its feet on a cold evening.

scenes.caption: A tear.
scenes.say: The prince weeps. He can see the suffering below.

scenes.caption: A ruby.
scenes.say: He gives his ruby to help a sick child.

scenes.caption: Sapphires.
scenes.say: His sapphire eyes go next. The swallow delivers them.

scenes.caption: Sadaqah.
scenes.say: Hamza thinks of sadaqah in Ramadan. Giving helps others.

scenes.caption: The moral.
scenes.say: True beauty is kindness, not gold. That is the moral.

scenes.caption: A plan.
scenes.say: Hamza plans a story of his own. It begins in a bazaar.
